nodes.label: Relative import inside phase agent causes ImportError at runtime

properties.symptom: ImportError: attempted relative import beyond top-level package

nodes.label: Always use absolute imports (aether_os.core.x) inside phase agents

properties.rule: from aether_os.X import Y — never from ..X import Y
properties.reason: Phase agents are loaded dynamically; relative imports fail

nodes.label: Generated app has no routers/__init__.py — imports fail at startup
Every generated routers/ directory must have __init__.py exporting all routers

properties.rule: p04a must write routers/__init__.py with from .X import router
properties.reason: FastAPI app.include_router requires importable router objects

nodes.label: Seed data hits UNIQUE constraint because email/username not unique per row
Seed generator must use unique values for email/username fields

properties.rule: For each entity row i, use email=f'user{i}@example.com'
properties.reason: Duplicate emails in seed data cause IntegrityError on first run

nodes.label: Circular FK reference causes seed data deadlock

properties.symptom: Cannot insert row: FK constraint fails in both directions

nodes.label: Break circular FK cycles by making one side nullable

properties.rule: If A→B and B→A, make B.a_id nullable=True so A can be inserted first
properties.reason: Nullable FK allows deferred insertion order resolution

nodes.label: Entity named Base/Session/Model conflicts with SQLAlchemy internals

properties.symptom: AttributeError or mysterious ORM behaviour at startup

nodes.label: Rename entities that conflict with SQLAlchemy reserved names

properties.rule: Never name an entity Base, Session, Model, Query, or metadata
properties.reason: SQLAlchemy imports these names into the ORM namespace
